page.overview:
Who is Chuntaro?

Chuntaro is a small sparrow with brown eyes and reddish brown plumage that is mostly white, in addition to a few black feathers on his face.

Chuntaro is a very intelligent sparrow, as well as brave and loyal, as he is often seen trying to motivate Zenitsu to keep going when he feels down, or staying by his side in high-risk situations, such as when he entered and stayed with him on Mount Natagumo, despite all the discomfort that Zenitsu constantly causes him.

Chuntaro has also been shown to be very sentimental, such as when he was seen happy after Tanjiro understood him and agreed to help him the first time they met, or when, after the battle with the Spider Demon, Chuntaro stood next to Zenitsu with tearful eyes.

Chuntaro passed the Kasugai Crow Test after his family was killed by demons. He would later be assigned as Zenitsu Agatsuma's crow after he passed the Final Selection to become Demon Slayer.
